Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all that we have from this tour! The Test series was shared between both of these teams but the T20I series has been cleaned up by Afghanistan. We have enjoyed bringing the coverage of this game and tour to you. Until next time. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Asghar Afghan, the Afghanistan captain, says that it is very important to win the series 3-0, as their morale will improve. Adds that they are missing some key players, but hopes that they will join them in the next series. Says that the other guys came and played and praises the coaching staff as they got some new players here.

KARIM JANAT IS THE PLAYER OF THE SERIES! He says that this is the first time that he has come in the top order and he took full toll of this opportunity. Feels that the wicket was slow and the ball was coming onto the bat slower.

NAJIBULLAH ZADRAN IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH! He says that getting to bat in the top order was good and he enjoyed his time there. Adds that when Afghan came to the crease, he told him that they will build a partnership for the next 3 overs, and then Zadran can go and play his natural strokes.

Sean Williams, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that looking at the Test series, it was sad to lose out on the T20I series and they will take some positives from this series and they will learn from this. Says that their bowling, towards the end of the innings, was bad, and losing wickets at the start of the innings was not good too.

Earlier, on the back of a quickfire innings from Najibullah Zadran and contributions from Usman Ghani, Asghar Afghan, and Karim Janat, Afghanistan managed to score 183. Zimbabwe, with the ball, were superb early on but then faltered at the fag end and conceded 78 runs in the final 6 overs which proved too much in the end for the Zimbabweans as they lost.

With the ball, Debutant Fazal Haque was brilliant as he picked up a wicket on his international debut. Nabi and Naveen-ul-Haq too managed a wicket each as Janat was impressive once again as he bagged a couple of wickets. Overall a superb bowling display from them see them take the series 3-0.

Chasing a total of 184 runs, Zimbabwe needed a strong start with the bat but they could not get one and in the end, faltered batting from them see them go down losing. A couple of batsmen did get starts but none could continue all over to take Zimbabwe over the line. Raza and Burl did try hard enough to keep Zimbabwe into the hunt but the task was too much to ask for as they went down fighting it hard.

They never got going with the bat, did the Rhodesians. They lost their first wicket, right in the first over and this is the trend, that followed for most of this run chase. They just kept losing wickets and there was no aggressor in the squad, who could attack from one end and keep the run flow going. Towards the end, Burl and Raza stitched an 80-run stand but this came really late into the game and it did not matter much, in the grand scheme of the game.

Easily done by Afghanistan in the end and they have deservedly won this series 3-0 and have whitewashed their counterparts, from Africa. Zimbabwe never looked like they were in the game, throughout the chase, and have been beaten by 47 runs.

SIX! A good way to finish the game but the game has gone the way of Afghanistan. On a good length and around off, Ryan Burl lofts this one nicely over the long on region for a biggie. AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 47 RUNS AND WIN THE T20I SERIES 3-0!
Another slower ball outside off, Ryan looks to slam this one away but misses.
EDGY FOUR. On a good length and around off, Burl looks to slog this one away but the ball takes the inside edge, goes through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
On a good length and around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Full toss around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on middle, lofted over covers and the batters take a couple. The throw is wayward and the batters come back for another run.
Slower back of a length ball outside off, punched to deep covers for a single.
Short and on middle, Ryan pulls this one to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Slower back of a length ball around off, SR guides this one to short third man for a single.
Slowish good length ball on middle, heaved away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A pacy bouncer outside off, Ryan Burl looks to pull this one to the leg side but he fails to get bat on ball on this occasion.
SIX! Too full and dispatched. Fuller, around off, Ryan Burl sends this one sailing over the ropes at long on.
Full toss on middle, bunted to long on for a single.
Another slower ball outside off, Burl looks to hoick this one to the leg side but fails to get any bat on this.
A good slower delivery outside off, Ryan Burl shuffles and looks to play the paddle scoop but misses.
On a fuller length and on middle, whipped to the long on region for a quick couple.
Fuller and on middle, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! SLAM! On a good length and on middle, Sikandar Raza swivels and bangs this one over deep mid-wicket. Great timing!
Full around off, guided to short third man for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Raza lofts this one over backward point, cleanly, this time for a couple. 100 up for Zimbabwe!
On a good length and outside off, Sikandar Raza looks to slam this one over the off side but the ball takes the outside edge and flies over backward point. A couple.

FOUR! Well played! A slower bouncer again around off this time, Sikandar Raza pulls this one, has not timed it all that well, but still enough for the ball to go all the way to the ropes at fine leg, after a couple of bounces.
A slower short ball around off and middle, Sikandar Raza moves away from the sticks and looks to slam this one through the off side but he misses.
Full, outside off, Sikandar Raza shuffles across and plays the scoop towards the fine leg region for a couple.
Fuller, tossed up, around off, Ryan looks to heave this one away but the ball takes the inside edge, and hits him on the pad. Just 5 off this one.
On middle, flicked to the on side for a single.
Leg bye. On the middle and leg pole, Burl looks to flick but misses and the ball takes the pad and goes to the off side. A leg bye taken.
Dropped! Hashmatullah Shahidi is the culprit on this occasion! Floated around off, full, Ryan Burl looks to smash this one through the covers but hits it uppishly, where Shahidi drops this one.
Flat, around off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full, flighted, around off, slogged away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! Superbly struck! Fullish on leg, Burl slogs it up and over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
WIDE! Shortish delivery outside off, Burl looks to pull but misses it. Wide called.
Floated on off, Raza plays it to long off for a single.
On off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Full delivery on leg, Burl looks to glance but he misses it to get hit on the boot. An appeal follows but nothing from the umpire.
Fuller on off, Raza squeezes it to deep cover for a single.
Shortish outside off, Raza plays it to point.
On leg, Raza plays it to long on for a single.
Fullish ball on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Fired full outside off, Burl looks to squeeze it but misses it.
Shortish outside off, Burl cuts it to point.
Floated around off, Burl goes for the reverse sweep but ends up getting a glove on it. The ball rolls to the third man region for a brace.
Shortish ball around off, Burl pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower and shorter around middle, Raza arches back and looks to upper cut it but he fails to connect the bat with the ball. 115 needed from the last 7 overs.
Short one around off, Burl pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single again. These runs won't bother Afghanistan.
Full and around leg, Raza tucks it around the corner for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and around middle, Raza stays on the back foot and then chips it straight down to long on for a boundary.
Slower short ball on off, Burl pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker on off, Burl digs it out to covers.
On middle, turned to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and around off, Burl punches it off the back foot to covers.
On middle, Raza works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around middle, tucked through square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
Fuller on off, driven straight to short cover.
Another length ball around off, Raza tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. Brilliant over from Janat.
Shortish around middle, Burl tucks it to square leg for a single.
No hat-trick on this occasion for Janat! Length ball on off, Burl fends it out off the front foot.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zimbabwe once again lose half the side very early! Janat strikes twice in two balls. Short of good length and around off, Mutumbami looks to fend it away to the off side but the extra bounce means that the ball takes the outside edge as Gurbaz collects it again. Janat is on a hat-trick here!
Karim Janat is on a hat-trick! Who will come out to face him? It is Ryan Burl!

OUT! CAUGHT! Zimbabwe tottering at 56/4! A nothing shot sees Milton Shumba walk back to the hut. Slower short ball around middle, Shumba shuffles across his off pole and looks to scoop it over the keeper. He though takes his eyes off the ball. The ball takes the edge and goes to the keeper where Gurbaz collects it.
Out comes Richmond Mutumbami!
Good length and around middle, Shumba goes for the pull but inside edges onto his pads.
Change. Karim Janat comes into the attack now.
Drags his length back this time and bowls this on the middle stump, Milton Shumba slaps this one through cover-point for a single. 128 more needed from 10 overs.
Gives this one nice air and lands it on off, Raza flicks this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Flat again, outside off, Raza slaps this one but only to the point fielder.
The reverse sweep is out now. This is hit through point for a single.
Flatter and on the pads, Milton looks to flick but the ball takes the inside edge, hits him on the pad and rolls to the off side.
Short and around off, punched to covers for a single.
Rashid Khan to bowl now.

Back of a length and around off, MS punches this to the left of the bowler, who does well to shuffle across and stop the ball well. Another good over for Afghanistan! Just 2 runs and also a wicket off this one.
Swing and a miss! Naveen-ul-Haq steams in, but bowls a slower short ball outside off, Milton Shumba gives the charge but his attempt to pull only connects with the thin air around him.
Around off, on a length, keeps a bit low as Milton looks to work this one to the leg side, but the ball takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Sikandar Raza is the new batsmen in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one falls for Zimbabwe and the third wicket is down here. This is another slower ball outside off, Tarisai Musakanda has to reach out and he looks to play this one over the mid off region. Does not time this one well and gifts an easy catch to Mohammad Nabi at the edge of the circle, near mid off. 132 more needed in 69 balls.
Runs in and bowls a length ball on middle, Shumba tucks this one through mid-wicket and rotates the strike. Zimbabwe need some boundaries here.
Around off, back of a length, Tarisai Musakanda moves off side and pushes this one towards square leg for a single.
On off and middle, played to the leg side for a single.
Around off, slightly short, Tarisai Musakanda goes back and punches this one through covers to collect a brace.
On middle and leg, fuller, Milton milks this one to long on for a single.
Given lot of air and lands this one around off, MS only pushes this one back to Nabi.
Around off, floated, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pushed to the on side for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! On a good length, but outside off, since Tarisai Musakanda is slightly leg side, he has to reach out to play this. He does not connect bat with ball. Just 4 runs off this one.
Slower and shorter outside off, Tarisai Musakanda just lets this one through.
On a good length and around off, Shumba looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man for as single.
A short ball now, on the middle pole, Tarisai Musakanda pulls this one to deep square leg for a single now.
On the body, short of a length, MS flicks this one to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE. Slips this one down the leg side, Milton Shumba looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
On a good length and around off, Milton keeps this one out.
Naveen-ul-Haq comes onto bowl now.
Short and on the pads, Milton nudges this one to mid on for a single. 9 runs and a wicket off Nabi's 3rd over. Zimbabwe are at 40/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Milton Shumba comes into bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Knocks him over! Sean Williams might have won the battle, but Mohammad Nabi has won the war! After being hit for two boundaries, Nabi comes back very nicely. Floated, full, around off, coming in with the angle, Sean Williams gets on his knees and looks to slog sweep this one away. He misses his stroke. You know the rest. 145 more needed in 85 balls.
Outside off, quicker too, shortish, SW cuts but finds the point fielder.

FOUR! Another one! Sean Williams is turning it up now. Full, floated, around middle, Sean Williams shuffles slightly to the off side and gets down on his knees. Sweeps this one nicely through backward square leg.
FOUR! Good placement and a boundary for Sean! Shortish and on middle, Williams heaves this one through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the ropes.
Shortish and around off, SW goes back and punches this one to covers.
Yorker outside off, Tarisai digs it out to the off side.
Good comeback from Haque! Good length and around off, Musakanda defends it out.
FOUR! Taking advantage of the Powerplay! Full and slower outside off, Tarisai throws his bat at it as he powers it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Handsomely done! Short and around middle, Musakanda waits for it before pulling it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

A huge appeal but not given by the umpire! Length ball angled on middle, Tarisai goes for hoick on the leg side but he cannot get the connection right as the ball hit him on the thigh pad before rolling to the off side. The bowler appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
On middle, milked to the leg side for a single.
Shortish around off, Williams slaps it on the bounce to mid off for a single.
Floated around middle, turned towards the leg side for a single. Sensible batting.
SIX! Slogged! Full and in the slot from Nabi, Tarisai gets down on one knee and slogs it through deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller and outside of, Tarisai drives it to covers.
Short and around off, Sean pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter around off, Tarisai shuffles across his crease to stroke it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Tarisai pushes his towards wide mid off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Tarisai goes for the cut but ends up chopping it behind to the keeper.
Short one angled around middle, Tarisai pulls but straight to backward square leg.
Back of a length and around off, Tarisai keeps it out off the back foot.
Short of good length and outside off, Musakanda goes for wild slash but misses it as the ball goes off the outside edge.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full and outside off, Tarisai flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary at wide long on.
On middle, tucked away through mid-wicket this time for a single. 177 off 108 balls for a win.
Flatter around middle, Musakanda pulls it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket. He misses to get it in the gap this time.
Slower and fuller on off, Tarisai pushes it back to the bowler.
Sliding on leg, Williams whips it away to deep square leg for a single.
Darted on off, Musakanda turns it to mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Floated around off, Williams pushes it down to long on for a single.

Short of good length around off, Williams punches it towards covers where the fielder misfields to allow a single. A brilliant first over in international cricket from Fazal Haque. Just three runs and a wicket from it.
Who will bowl from the other end? Spin time as Mohammad Nabi has the ball in hand.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! MAIDEN T20I WICKET FOR HAQUE! What a sight for any fast bowler. Length and angled across once again and Tinashe looks to heave it over the cow-corner fence. He though does not get to the pitch of the ball as he plays the heave. The ball takes the inside edge and crashes into the stumps. Early blow for Zimbabwe once again. 182 more needed to win.
Skipper, Sean Williams comes out now!
Good length and around off, Tinashe blocks it out.
Length and angled outside off, Tarisai looks to drive it down the ground but the bat twists in his hand and the ball rolls to mid off. A single taken.
Fuller and around off, Tinashe strokes it towards mid off and gets off the mark with a single. So are Zimbabwe too.
Full and angled outside off, Tinashe looks to lay bat on ball but is beaten completely.
